data.gender_notes: Aabeer is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Fragrance; perfume; aroma; a beautiful scent
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿabīr (عبير) 'fragrance, perfume, aroma', from the root ʿ-b-r. A well-attested feminine Arabic given name; the same root gives ʿabara 'to cross, to interpret'. Aabeer therefore means “Fragrance; perfume; aroma; a beautiful scent”. Arabic feminine given name ʿAbīr 'fragrance'; attested in Arabic poetry and modern usage.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabeer expresses “A star or shining one”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabeer total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

faq.q: What is the difference between Aabeer and Aabir?
faq.a: Aabeer (عبير) means 'fragrance, perfume' and is normally a girl's name. Aabir (عابر) means 'passer-by, one who crosses' and is normally a boy's name. They share the root ʿ-b-r but are different words.

faq.q: What does the name Aabeer mean?
faq.a: Aabeer means “Fragrance; perfume; aroma; a beautiful scent”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aabeer come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aabeer?
faq.a: The root of Aabeer is ع-ب-ر (ʿ-b-r).

faq.q: How is Aabeer written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aabeer is written عبير in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aabeer a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabeer is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aabeer appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabeer is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabeer verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Fragrance; perfume; aroma; a beautiful scent” is established by Arabic feminine given name ʿAbīr 'fragrance'; attested in Arabic poetry and modern usage..
